Buttons

Filled, tonal, outlined, elevated, text, and floating actions.

There are several button types described in Material Design: the elevated button, the filled, tonal, outlined, text, and floating button.

Standard Button

Filled (Standard)

The filled button communicates high emphasis actions. Add the class filled to provide this style. This should be the main action on a page, so be careful. A good rule of thumb is to add just one primary action per page or field of view.

Create addCreate editUpdate 

<a class="btn filled">Create</a>
<a class="btn filled icon-left">
  <i class="material-icons">add</i>Create
</a>
<a class="btn filled icon-right rounded waves-effect waves-light">
  <i class="material-icons">edit</i>Update
</a>

Tonal

Tonal buttons communicate a medium emphasis action. Add the class tonal to the button. These can be used more often on a page because they are additional actions next to the primary action.

Create addCreate addCreate 

<a class="btn tonal">Create</a>
<a class="btn tonal icon-left">
  <i class="material-icons">add</i>Create
</a>
<a class="btn tonal icon-right waves-effect">
  <i class="material-icons">add</i>Create
</a>

Outlined

The outlined button communicates a medium emphasis action. Add the class outlined to the button.

Create addCreate addCreate 

<a class="btn outlined">Create</a>
<a class="btn outlined icon-left">
  <i class="material-icons">add</i>Create
</a>
<a class="btn outlined icon-right waves-effect">
  <i class="material-icons">add</i>Create
</a>

Elevated

The elevated button is a tonal button with a shadow. It signifies medium emphasis actions and seeks to give depth to a mostly flat page. Try to only use shadows when absolutely necessary, to prevent shadow creep. Also keep in mind that on darker backgrounds the shadows are less visible.

Create addCreate addCreate Create addCreate 

<a class="btn elevated">Create</a>
<a class="btn elevated icon-left">
  <i class="material-icons">add</i>Create
</a>
<a class="btn elevated icon-right">
  <i class="material-icons">add</i>Create
</a>
<a class="btn elevated rounded">Create</a>
<a class="btn elevated icon-left rounded">
  <i class="material-icons">add</i>Create
</a>

Text

Text buttons are used to reduce excessive layering and communicate low emphasis actions. For example, text buttons are used for actions within a card or modal so there are not too many overlapping shadows. btn-flat is an alias of btn text.

Create addCreate 

<a class="btn text">Create</a>
<button class="btn text icon-left">
  <i class="material-icons">add</i>Create
</button>
<a class="btn text icon-right waves-effect">
  <i class="material-icons">add</i>Create
</a>

Floating

A circular material button. Use btn-floating, and optionally btn-large or btn-small.

add 

<a class="btn-floating btn-large waves-effect waves-light">
  <i class="material-icons">add</i>
</a>
Floating Action Button

A circular material button that lifts and can expand a menu of related actions. Wrap one or more btn-floating buttons in a fixed-action-btn container to pin it to the corner of the page. See the Floating Action Button page for menus, directions, and the JavaScript API.

Helpers

Submit Button

When you use a button to submit a form, instead of using an input tag, use a button tag with type="submit".

<button class="btn filled icon-right waves-effect waves-light" type="submit" name="action">
  Submit<i class="material-icons">send</i>
</button>

Large

This button has a larger height for buttons that need more attention.

<a class="btn-large filled icon-right waves-effect waves-light">

Small

When mouse and keyboard are the primary input methods, this smaller button is useful for denser UI layouts.

Button cloudbutton cloudbutton

</a>

Rounded

Add rounded for a pill-shaped button.

Rounded 

<a class="btn filled rounded">Rounded</a>
